## What's Changed
* Download page: pick versions by semantic version; offer the latest release and a newer pre-release by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/83
* Website redesign: app icon, light/dark theme, new pages with real screenshots by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/85
* Controllers: map the pad in use correctly (8BitDo, RPCS3, RetroArch, Xenia) by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/86
* Controller screen: set up a pad for each platform by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/87
* Controller screen: more emulators and a drawing of each platform's controller by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/88
* Controller screen: xemu, PPSSPP and Xenia, PSP controller, Xbox invert switches by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/89
* melonDS: joystick number, login as the DS name, language/colour/birthday options by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/90
* CI: manual artifact retention workflow; uploads keep artifacts 5 days by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/91
* Controller test, controller database, Nintendo glyphs, single-pad mapping screen by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/92
* Pad button styles from a rules table by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/93
* CI: native app artifact only on a manual run; 1-day retention by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/94
* Report a problem as a step-by-step wizard; short report references by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/96
* Release: attach installers straight to the release (no artifact storage) by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/97


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/compare/v1.0.0-rc.1...v1.0.1-rc.1
